title: when a slice adds a struct field that its tests read, have the base overlay also revert those test files so the revert check builds

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-203305-0dc5, project ork, item S579:

when a slice adds a struct field that its tests read, have the base overlay also revert those test files so the revert check builds

Evidence: in the review round overlay-1.json reverted only roadmap.go and the build failed with "pane.page undefined" at matrix_test.go:201 and roadmap_test.go:629
